## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Publora

### What makes Publora different from other schedulers?

Most tools focus on when to post. Publora focuses on what to post and how to stay consistent. It's built to support creators with a clean, minimalist space that helps you think clearly, stay focused, and create without distractions.

### What platforms does Publora support?

Publora supports 10 major social media platforms: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky, X (Twitter), Mastodon, LinkedIn, and Telegram. We're constantly adding support for new platforms. To request a specific platform be added, please send an email to support@publora.com , or request a feature here .

### Is there a limit to how many posts I can schedule?

No, there's no limit to the number of posts you can schedule. Our platform is designed to handle your content needs, whether you're posting once a day or multiple times across different platforms.

### Can I manage multiple accounts?

Yes! You can manage multiple accounts across different platforms from a single dashboard. This makes it easy to maintain consistent branding and messaging across all your social media presence.

### How far in advance can I schedule posts?

You can schedule posts for up to 2 months in advance. If you need more than that, please contact us.
